configPanel.privacyOnDevice: Your facts and topics are stored exclusively on your device: AI inference runs entirely on-device via the Mera Protocol. Each time you need news, only your topic phrases are sent to fetch articles, carrying no user ID (turn on Inject noise above to send decoys alongside them). Those phrases are cached on our servers keyed by the text alone and dropped after 14 days unused; nothing records that you were the one who asked. What we keep about you is your login email, your subscription status, and a per-day count of analysed articles used to enforce your plan. Chat sessions start fresh and aren't saved: the one exception is that if you submit an unblock request, the transcript you attach is stored for review. Switching devices or logging out means rebuilding your persona. Our backend isn't published yet; we're moving every service that touches your data into a source-available repository and expect it public before September 2026. Until then the one thing you take on trust is that we keep no record linking you to your topics. Mera is built in the Netherlands under the EU's GDPR, and not holding your data is the point of the design.
configPanel.privacyCloud: Your facts and topics are stored exclusively on your device. Cloud inference uses encrypted Trusted Execution Environments (TEE): your data is encrypted on-device to the key the enclave publishes, processed in an isolated enclave, and decrypted only on your device. Being precise: the app doesn't yet check that attestation against the hardware vendor, so for now you're trusting us and the enclave operator rather than the chip; making the app verify it and refuse to continue is on our roadmap. freeTier.cardBody: Mera isn't building your feed right now. Everything you've already saved, tracked, and read stays exactly where it is. For today's headlines, Explore is open to you.
freeTier.trackTitle: Story tracking comes with a plan
freeTier.trackBody: The stories you already follow keep everything they've collected — starting a new one needs an active plan.
freeTier.readOnlyBanner: Everything here is yours to read, plan or no plan. These settings only change what Mera does while a plan is active.
freeTier.chatNotice: Mera chat comes with a plan. Your persona and facts stay on this device either way.
freeTier.chatBubble: Everything I know about you stays right here on this device. An active plan switches me back on, so we can talk and I can tune your feed again.
freeTier.storiesNotice: The stories you already follow keep everything they've collected. Starting a new one needs an active plan.
freeTier.trackedStoriesEmptyBody: Nothing followed yet. Following a story comes with a plan — and whatever you follow later stays on this device, yours to keep.
freeTier.lapseBody: Nothing has been taken away. Your saved articles, tracked stories, and reading history are yours, on this device, always. You're on Mera News Free from here: what pauses is the AI layer itself — your personalized feed, dashboard, new story tracking, and Mera chat.
